entities.summary: Haile Selassie I, a notable figure in the history of Jamaica, associated with Labour Movement, Marcus Garvey, and Self-Governance (1930–1962). Preceded by Rise of Rastafari and Garvey founds UNIA in Kingston 1914. Their legacy influenced 1938 Labour Uprising and the Birth of Party Politics and Frome Sugar Estate.
